effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` PYUSD to the vault, using their PYUSD allowance to the vault (enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
The vault mints senPYUSDPST shares to onBehalf. The number is previewDeposit(assets), set by the vault's share price after fees accrue. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit 2 PYUSD for the onBehalf address. The share ticker senPYUSDPST and the share recipient are shown; the number of shares is not.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown and has no minimum in the calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` uses the share price from storage and adapters. Case 0: 2e18 senPYUSDPST in to the signer, not on the screen, which shows only the 'Share ticker' senPYUSDPST.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix. The amount depends on the on-chain price. Labelling it 'Receive shares (amount set by vault price)' could help.

cases.notes: The 2 PYUSD out is shown right. The share recipient and ticker are shown, but not the 2 senPYUSDPST amount, which nothing on screen bounds. The reader knew the shares arrive but not how many.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns senPYUSDPST shares from onBehalf. The number is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up and set by the vault's share price. There is no maximum.
If the signer is not onBehalf, the signer's share allowance from onBehalf drops by the shares burned.
Exactly `assets` PYUSD goes to receiver. The vault may first pull liquidity from its adapter.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 126000 PYUSD to the receiver, with the owner whose shares pay for it. The number of shares burned is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the senPYUSDPST shares burned from the owner are not shown and have no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` then deleteShares(onBehalf, shares). Case 2: 125820.005616134857097151 senPYUSDPST out from the signer; the screen shows only 'Withdraw exactly 126000 PYUSD'.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix: the share cost depends on the vault price at execution. The intent could still say that vault shares are burned, e.g. 'Withdraw {assets} by burning senPYUSDPST shares'.

cases.notes: The 126000 PYUSD in to the signer is shown right. The reader knew shares or balance leave but did not see that 125820.0056 senPYUSDPST were burned.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` senPYUSDPST from onBehalf.
If the signer is not onBehalf, the signer's share allowance from onBehalf drops by `shares`.
receiver gets PYUSD equal to previewRedeem(shares), set by the vault price. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem the given senPYUSDPST shares to the receiver, with the owner. Neither the PYUSD asset nor its amount is named.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says PYUSD is received, though the descriptor has the underlying ticker constant.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. The redeem fields in descriptor.json are only shares, receiver and onBehalf. Unlike mint, there is no `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` field. Case 3: 189290.131067 PYUSD in to the signer; the reader wrote 'Underlying asset (likely PYUSD, not stated)'.
findings.fix: Add a field {label:'Receive asset', format:'raw', value:'$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker'} and make the intent 'Redeem {#.shares} for PYUSD to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the PYUSD amount received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);` uses the price from storage and adapters. Case 3: 189290.131067 PYUSD in, no amount on screen.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix: the amount depends on the vault price.

cases.notes: The share burn is shown right. For the PYUSD in, the reader got the receiver but guessed the asset and had no amount.

effects: The signer pays PYUSD to the vault, using their PYUSD allowance. The amount is previewMint(shares), rounded up and set by the vault price. There is no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` senPYUSDPST to onBehalf.
formats.shown: Mint 1 senPYUSDPST for the onBehalf address, with PYUSD named as the deposit asset but no PYUSD amount.

findings.title: mint: the PYUSD amount taken from the signer is not shown and has no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` then safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, ...). Case 1: 1 PYUSD out from the signer; the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: PYUSD'.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix: the cost depends on the vault price. The deposit-asset label could say 'amount set by vault price, limited by your PYUSD approval'.

findings.title: mint: the intent says 'Mint ... for' and does not say that PYUSD leaves the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'. Case 1 screen: 'Mint 1 senPYUSDPST for 0x...dEaD', while 1 PYUSD left the signer.

cases.notes: The PYUSD out is shown as an asset with no amount; the reader knew PYUSD leaves but not how much. The shares went to 0x...dEaD, which the screen showed and the reader understood; that is not a signer effect.
